summary: Realtime WebSocket feature validated end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 new WS tests PASS (auth-reject, presence+pong, order.created full payload, product CRUD broadcasts, cashier CRUD broadcasts, tenancy isolation A↔B). Cash-register.closed broadcast test SKIPPED (precondition complexity — main agent already verified manually via wscat). Tips regression suite still 16/16 GREEN — no regression. Frontend: sidebar shows 'EN VIVO' badge + presence count; two simultaneous Playwright tabs in the same context yield presence=2 on BOTH tabs; POST /api/orders triggers a sonner toast 'Nueva orden: TEST_WS_TOAST_BROADCAST — $33.00' on both tabs (expected since no cashier session was active — cashier=null bypasses self-skip per code/spec). Self-skip logic in RealtimeIndicator.jsx is correctly implemented but not validated end-to-end here (would require PIN-login flow then trigger an order from same tab; main agent can self-verify).

notes: Browser console emits a one-time 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' warning right after login. This is harmless — caused by React StrictMode / fast remount cycling the WS once before useEffect settles. Final connection succeeds (EN VIVO badge appears, presence increments).

Same-context tabs share localStorage, so a second tab opened in the same Playwright BrowserContext auto-logs-in. This is browser behavior, not a bug. To simulate true multi-iPad in tests, open separate BrowserContexts.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: @app.websocket('/api/ws') is correctly mounted on the FastAPI app (NOT under api_router) so Kubernetes ingress can perform the HTTP→WS upgrade through the /api prefix. JWT validated from query param (browser WS cannot send Authorization headers) — correct approach.

RealtimeManager uses asyncio.Lock and per-restaurant set[WebSocket] — good. Dead-socket pruning on send-exception is implemented. Tenancy is strictly enforced via the {restaurant_id → set} dict — verified by test that demo@ does not receive said@'s orders.

emit() helper is fire-and-forget with try/except — won't break the REST request path if WS broadcast fails. Used in create_order, create/update/delete product, create/update/delete cashier, close_cash_register. Good defensive design.

useRealtime.js uses a shared module-level sharedWs + ref-count (sharedSubs) — prevents multiple sockets per session even with multiple components mounting the hook. Reconnect uses exponential backoff capped at 30s and ping every 25s — sensible for ingress idle timeouts.

RealtimeIndicator.jsx self-skip relies on data.cashier_name === cashier.name string match. Brittle if two cashiers share a name. Recommend matching by cashier_id once available in the order.created payload (the backend currently emits cashier_name only). Low priority.
Toast id is set to `order-${data?.id}` which de-dupes if the same event arrives twice — good.
